Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing routes an input to a subset of specialized "expert" subnetworks and combines their outputs. A gating network (often a small linear layer or router) computes scores for each expert, typically via softmax over logits. Top-k selection keeps only the k highest-scoring experts, zeroing the rest to save compute.
